result.brief: 提出内在分布匹配（IDM），将反向KL场分解为高斯矩分量与非高斯残差，用生成器EMA特征显式约束特征均值与标准差，替代外部DINOv2编码器，实现少步文生图蒸馏。
result.reason: Distribution matching distillation for few-step text-to-image; uses EMA generator features instead of external DINOv2 encoder, a representation/feature-space supervision contribution with transfer to video generation.
